product.title: Private Guided Backcountry E-Bike Tour

description.text: Pedal beyond crowded viewpoints on a private e-bike tour customized to your fitness level around Whitefish and West Glacier backroads. Your guide leads a worry-free day of crowd-free riding to scenic pullouts, forest roads, and park-adjacent trails that standard visitors rarely reach.

highlights: Private e-bike tour tailored to your group
Custom route around Whitefish and West Glacier backcountry
Guide-selected scenic roads away from main park crowds

start.description: Meet your guide at the confirmed Whitefish or West Glacier staging area. Helmet fitting and route briefing precede the ride.

end.description: Return e-bikes to the staging area after the final backroad loop.

product.itinerarySummary: Pedal beyond crowded viewpoints on a private e-bike tour customized to your fitness level around Whitefish and West Glacier backroads.

itineraryItems.title: Whitefish
itineraryItems.description: Optional start from Whitefish area trails and forest roads selected for your group.

itineraryItems.title: Apgar Village
itineraryItems.description: Ride toward Apgar Village and lakeshore paths with views of Lake McDonald.

itineraryItems.title: Going-to-the-Sun Road
itineraryItems.description: Cycle selected lower-elevation sections of Going-to-the-Sun Road when seasonal bike access allows.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Private Guided Backcountry E-Bike Tour?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 4 to 6 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from near Glacier National Park?
faqs.answer: Meet your guide at the confirmed Whitefish or West Glacier staging area. Helmet fitting and route briefing precede the ride.
